archetypes.title: The Wanderer
archetypes.outcome: A new corner of the server becomes familiar
archetypes.meaning: You grow by moving toward what feels unfamiliar instead of waiting for perfect certainty.
archetypes.guidance: Follow one genuine curiosity today and let the destination reveal itself slowly.

archetypes.title: The Crownless King
archetypes.outcome: An unlikely team asks for your guidance
archetypes.meaning: Your influence comes from making people feel capable, heard and welcome beside you.
archetypes.guidance: Lead by giving someone else room to shine before claiming the center.

archetypes.title: The Last Witness
archetypes.outcome: You notice the detail everyone missed
archetypes.meaning: Your quiet observation catches patterns that louder voices often pass without seeing.
archetypes.guidance: Pause before answering. The smallest detail may completely change your next choice.

archetypes.title: The Trickster
archetypes.outcome: Your silly idea unexpectedly saves the day
archetypes.meaning: You break stale patterns through humor, improvisation and a refusal to accept boring answers.
archetypes.guidance: Try the playful solution, but make sure the people beside you are enjoying the joke too.
